_meta.metric: Scope 3 Cat 5 waste — treatment emission factors, country treatment mix, and generation benchmarks
_meta.unit: treatment_ef: kg CO2e per tonne; treatment_mix: share of tonnes (sum≈1); generation: kg per FTE per year
_meta.source: DEFRA 2024 (treatment factors) + World Bank What a Waste (country treatment mix)

sources.treatment_ef_kg_per_tonne: UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2025 GHG Conversion Factors — Waste disposal (Commercial & industrial / Refuse). Recycling & incineration reflect DEFRA's disposal scope (transport-only / energy-recovery credited); landfill carries the methane burden.
sources.treatment_mix_by_country: World Bank 'What a Waste' Global Database (country dataset). Raw treatment shares consolidated into 4 buckets and renormalised to sum to 1 over reported methods.
sources.generation_kg_per_fte_year: Screening order-of-magnitude defaults for commercial waste per employee — NOT a single citable figure; the SME should provide actual tonnage for accuracy. REEB (Better Buildings Partnership) building intensities are the intended refinement source.

treatment_ef_kg_per_tonne._source: DEFRA 2024: C&I waste Landfill 520.53, Incineration w/ energy recovery 4.69; recycling open-loop 4.69; organic composting/AD 8.98 (kg CO2e/tonne)
